hero.title: Tracing Each Oyster from Tide to Table
hero.kicker: The largest shellfish producer in the United States, Taylor Shellfish Farms, uses ArcGIS software throughout its operations. Smart maps and spatial analysis help the company overcome challenges of ocean acidification, increase yield, track farm bed contents, collect and share data with easy-to-use field apps, and access real-time data on farm conditions.

strengthen.title: Improve the efficiency of your production.
strengthen.paragraph: Whether you are managing the earth's resources or your field and staff resources, ArcGIS software enables you to streamline workflows and maximize productivity. Spatial insights reveal new patterns and trends to help you make better-informed decisions that will help your organization thrive.
